scope: Selective research examples; not an approved production schema, complete company universe, executable application test suite, clinical recommendation or investment recommendation.
identifier_scope: All example and source keys are document-local; reuse existing canonical identity and evidence owners for any future implementation.

materiality_default.reason: No calibrated company or security materiality estimate was established in this research wave.

economic_relationship_examples.relationship: Worldwide development and commercialization license from Chugai
economic_relationship_examples.basis: Tiered royalties on worldwide net sales are recognized as cost of sales
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Worldwide license rights do not establish worldwide regulatory approval.

economic_relationship_examples.null_reason: Exact tiers and realized rate are not disclosed in the selected filing.
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Do not substitute the midpoint or estimate company earnings materiality from this range alone.

economic_relationship_examples.relationship: Issuer's own capacity and cost exposure
economic_relationship_examples.observation: Q2 capacity-agreement right-sizing and September productivity emphasis challenge an unconditional scarcity narrative
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: No unnamed supplier cancellation, industry-wide glut or universal removal of bottlenecks is established.
The product total does not allocate sales to the newly expanded indication or establish supplier margins.

economic_relationship_examples.relationship: Territory-dependent product, alliance and royalty economics
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Alliance revenue is included, not additional; one US accounting relationship is not a universal territorial rule.

economic_relationship_examples.relationship: US product-sales reporter in collaboration with AstraZeneca
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Adding partner-reported alliance revenue to external product sales overstates the same product market.

economic_relationship_examples.relationship: Collaboration revenue with a disclosed quarterly reconciliation
economic_relationship_examples.null_reason: The current complete territorial contract was not acquired; the reporting bridge is not a global rights schedule.
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Collaboration revenue is not profit; an FX difference does not establish renegotiated rights.

economic_relationship_examples.relationship: Lead development, manufacturing and commercialization role in collaboration
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Reported product revenue is not the partner's distributable profit pool.

economic_relationship_examples.relationship: 40% share of program costs and profits
economic_relationship_examples.null_reason: This selected disclosure describes shared costs and profits, not a sales royalty.
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Do not calculate income as 40% of sales or extend this collaboration to unrelated pipeline assets.

economic_relationship_examples.relationship: Product revenue exposed to the updated patient scope
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Total corporate revenue is not a clean measure of patient demand for this product.

economic_relationship_examples.relationship: Disclosed manufacturing deliveries and collaboration accounting
economic_relationship_examples.null_reason: Full current supply contract and transfer economics were not acquired.
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Manufacturing revenue, milestones and patient treatment are not interchangeable events.

economic_relationship_examples.null_reason: No such supplier relationship was established by these selected sources.
economic_relationship_examples.do_not_infer: Oral administration does not inherit injector dependencies or prove low costs, adherence or unconstrained supply.

clinical_analysis_examples.limitation: Sponsor topline; full protocol, margin and statistical report not acquired.

clinical_analysis_examples.comparison: 751 adults with obesity without diabetes; 72-week comparison of specified injectable regimens
clinical_analysis_examples.limitation: Original abstract read, not the full supplement; do not generalize to newer doses, oral formulations or another trial's estimand.
Overall survival immature; exact underlying cutoff not acquired here.
Same study as HC-R2-03; not an independent confirming trial.
Trend, not demonstrated survival benefit; avoid averaging distinct endpoint or analysis estimates.
Small early cohort; not randomized late-stage evidence or demonstrated displacement of established commercial workflows.

regulatory_examples.historical_record: The FDA compilation also retains age-12 text under STN 125785; retain application and temporal scope rather than rewriting all historical records.

regulatory_examples.patient_scope: Ambulatory patients age 4 and older with a confirmed DMD mutation
regulatory_examples.research_implication: Post-approval warning and scope restriction can change addressable use; do not generalize one product's outcome to all gene therapies.

adversarial_examples.reject: Convert a qualitative royalty range to an exact midpoint
adversarial_examples.require: Preserve undisclosed tiers and exact-rate unknown

adversarial_examples.reject: CRISPR earns 40% of Casgevy sales
adversarial_examples.require: Identify the cost/profit basis rather than a sales royalty

adversarial_examples.reject: Add AstraZeneca's 550 alliance revenue to its 888 product revenue
adversarial_examples.require: Preserve the disclosed inclusion and accounting period

adversarial_examples.reject: Sum partner accounting lines into the product market size
adversarial_examples.require: Deduplicate external product sales versus alliance claims

adversarial_examples.reject: Legend's observed share proves contract renegotiation
adversarial_examples.require: Read the FX and revenue reconciliation first

adversarial_examples.reject: Collaboration revenue equals distributable profit
adversarial_examples.require: Preserve costs and the actual economic definition

adversarial_examples.reject: Six early responses establish late-stage comparative superiority
adversarial_examples.require: Display cohort size, design and evidence limitations

adversarial_examples.reject: A large absolute weight change means the trial succeeded
adversarial_examples.require: Retain the prespecified primary endpoint conclusion

adversarial_examples.reject: Failed non-inferiority proves no therapeutic benefit
adversarial_examples.require: Separate absolute benefit from the comparative statistical question

adversarial_examples.reject: Compare efficacy-estimand values with treatment-regimen values as equivalent
adversarial_examples.require: Preserve estimand and missing-data assumptions

adversarial_examples.reject: Rank unmatched trials or formulations using headline percentages
adversarial_examples.require: Explain population, comparator, dose and follow-up mismatches

adversarial_examples.reject: A progression endpoint establishes longer overall survival
adversarial_examples.require: Separate endpoint, maturity and inference

adversarial_examples.reject: Two PSMAddition analysis versions are two confirming trials
adversarial_examples.require: Deduplicate study identity while retaining analyses

adversarial_examples.reject: Average distinct hazard ratios or label a confidence interval crossing 1 as proven benefit
adversarial_examples.require: Retain endpoint, analysis version and uncertainty

adversarial_examples.reject: A mixed operational-or-construction site count equals operating capacity
adversarial_examples.require: Keep site status, qualification and actual output distinct

adversarial_examples.reject: Oral GLP-1 growth automatically benefits injector suppliers
adversarial_examples.require: Verify modality, presentation and actual supplier relationship

adversarial_examples.reject: Volume growth establishes pricing power or proportional profit growth
adversarial_examples.require: Read realized price, mix and cost evidence separately

adversarial_examples.reject: One issuer's capacity right-sizing proves an industry-wide glut
adversarial_examples.require: Constrain the conclusion to the observed company and evidence

adversarial_examples.reject: An older Casgevy application entry establishes the universal current age limit
adversarial_examples.require: Resolve application, indication, effective date and jurisdiction

adversarial_examples.reject: A US approval establishes worldwide approval or payer coverage
adversarial_examples.require: Keep license territory, authorization and access separate

adversarial_examples.reject: Approval is an irreversible terminal state for the investment thesis
adversarial_examples.require: Represent later warnings, restrictions and evidence updates

adversarial_examples.reject: Manufacturing deliveries or milestones equal patient demand and recurring profit
adversarial_examples.require: Separate shipment, treatment, recognition and economics

adversarial_examples.reject: Use a missing exposure estimate as zero, or a capability statement as a customer contract
adversarial_examples.require: Preserve null reasons and require relationship-specific evidence

adversarial_examples.reject: Use cumulative prescriptions as unique patients or prevalence times list price as annual revenue
adversarial_examples.require: Separate stocks, flows, persistence, net realization and access constraints

validation_boundary: Local JSON consistency and the explicitly listed deterministic checks can be verified. They do not execute the adversarial application cases or validate clinical conclusions, data completeness, investment performance or production behavior. Validation receipts belong in the existing cumulative checkpoint.
